title: Layouts aur Template Inheritance
objectives: `@parent`, default values aur `@stack` ka basic use jaanna

sections.heading: Layout kya hai?
sections.body: Website ke har page par header, navbar aur footer same hote hain. Har page mein dohrane ki jagah ek **layout** banate ho aur har page sirf apna content deta hai. Blade mein layout banane ke do tareeke hain: **components** aur **template inheritance**. Naye projects mein docs components wala tareeka pehle batate hain.

sections.heading: Tareeka 1: Layout component (recommended)
sections.body: Layout ek component hai jisme `{{ $slot }}` mein page ka content aata hai aur named slot `title` mein page ka title.

code.code:
Home Products
{{ $slot }}
© Laravel Master

explain: Tag ke andar ka content `{{ $slot }}` mein jaata hai.
`<x-slot:title>` – naam wala slot, layout mein `{{ $title }}` ban jaata hai.
Slot na ho to `$title ?? 'default'` se default title.
`route('home')` ke liye `home` naam ka route hona chahiye.

callout.text: Layout mein CSS/JS ke liye `@vite([...])` lagate hain (lesson 05). Abhi seekhte waqt use mat lagao, warna build ke bina 'Vite manifest not found' error aayega.

sections.heading: Tareeka 2: Template inheritance (@extends)
sections.body: Yeh purana par abhi bhi poori tarah supported tareeka hai. Layout mein `@yield` se jagah chhodte ho, aur child page `@section` se bharta hai.
explain: `@yield('content')` – layout mein jagah. Child `@section('content') ... @endsection` se bharta hai.
`@push('scripts')` / `@stack('scripts')` – child ka script layout ke neeche daalne ke liye.
`@parent` – child section mein layout ka original content bhi rakhna ho to.

sections.heading: Kaunsa tareeka chunein?
sections.body: Naya project ho to **component layout** chuno: saaf hai aur slots, props aur attributes ke saath achha chalta hai. Purane projects ya tutorials mein `@extends` milega, usse padhna zaroor aana chahiye, kyunki dono tareeke ek hi project mein saath chal sakte hain.

versionDiff.heading: Layouts: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: Dono tareeke (components aur `@extends`) teeno versions mein kaam karte hain.

items.11: Components (`<x-...>`) aur `@extends` dono supported. Starter kits ke apne layouts hote hain.
items.13: Same as 11. `<x-slot:title>` jaisa short slot syntax standard hai.

errors.cause: Layout file ka path galat hai.
errors.fix: `layouts.app` ka matlab `resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php`. Folder aur naam check karo.

errors.error: Undefined variable $slot / content dikh nahi raha
errors.cause: Component use kiya par tag ke andar content nahi diya, ya `@extends` aur component ko mila diya.
errors.fix: Ek page mein ek hi tareeka rakho: `<x-layout>` ya `@extends` + `@section`.

errors.error: Section ka content do baar aa raha hai ya gayab hai
errors.cause: `@section` ko `@endsection` se band nahi kiya, ya child mein `@extends` ke bahar content likha.
errors.fix: `@extends` wale child mein sab content `@section` ke andar likho.

debug.body: Layout ka koi hissa nahi dikh raha to view cache clear karo aur browser mein 'View Source' dekho.

tasks: `<x-layout>` component banao jisme navbar, `{{ $slot }}` aur footer ho
Do pages (`home`, `about`) us layout ke saath banao, har ek ka alag title do
Wahi layout `@extends` + `@yield` se bhi banao aur farak dekho
Ek page par `@push('scripts')` se chhota script jodo

quiz.q: Component layout mein page ka content kahan aata hai?
quiz.why: Tag ke andar ka default content `$slot` mein aata hai.
`@yield` layout mein jagah chhodta hai, child `@section` se bharta hai.

quiz.q: Naam wala slot kaise likhte hain?

interview.a: Header, navbar, footer jaisa common hissa ek jagah rakhne ke liye, taaki har page mein dohrana na pade.
`@extends` mein layout `@yield` se aur child `@section` se bharta hai. Component layout mein `<x-layout>` ke andar content `$slot` aur named slots mein jaata hai.
Child page se layout ke kisi jagah (jaise body ke end) script/style daalne ke liye.
Child section mein layout ke section ka original content bhi shaamil karta hai.

interview.q: Layout mein page title kaise badalte hain?
interview.a: Component mein `<x-slot:title>` se, ya `@extends` mein `@section('title', '...')` se.

summary: Layout common header/footer ek jagah rakhta hai.
`@push`/`@stack` se page-specific script ya style daalte hain.
Ek page mein ek hi tareeka use karo.
